data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with various Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Includes LLM cost over time (line chart)
Shows stage completion rates (bar chart)
Displays success rate trends (area chart)

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js for data visualization within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Includes pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates visualizations
Uses various chart types: line, bar, area, pie, and radar
Charts are interactive and animated

features.title: Features Showcase
features.description: Display features such as cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning with charts.
acceptance_criteria: Includes charts for cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics
Data is presented clearly and concisely
Charts are interactive and visually appealing

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Visualize TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance and SOLID principles
Data is accurate and up-to-date
Chart is easy to interpret

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Accurately represents all 8 stages
Uses an appropriate chart type for clarity
Includes labels and descriptions for each stage

features.title: Results Presentation
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent runs with actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Includes real data from recent Artemis runs
Data is presented in a clear and engaging manner
Charts reflect the latest available metrics

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents integration data
Includes labels for each segment
Chart is interactive and visually clear

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Implement a professional design with gradient backgrounds and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Uses a gradient background throughout the presentation
Includes smooth transitions between slides
Design is visually impressive and cohesive

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Add functionality for slides to auto-advance with navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Users can manually navigate slides using controls
Navigation is intuitive and responsive

features.title: HTML Presentation Template
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file using existing demos as templates.
acceptance_criteria: Utilizes templates from /home/bbrelin/src/repos/salesforce/slides/
Embeds CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js within a single HTML file
File is named artemis_demo_chartjs.html and saved to /tmp/

features.title: HERO Slide: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create an introductory slide explaining Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Clearly defines Artemis and its capabilities
Uses engaging visuals and text
Sets the stage for subsequent content
